answer: A bond is refunded only after 34 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. The onyx counter is kept in grove and lantern shows each reset. A hostile operator hence has to keep every sock puppet continuously active for 34 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A farm of 4634 identities would post 3189 proofs and burn roughly 19 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
